Azúcar's keeping a secret 🤫💋 We're finally unveiling OUR OWN burlesque troop — Sappholicious — and mama, it's about to get sultry. Hosted by La Bon, this ain't your average show: think seductive choreo, straight-up pool table tricks (yes, you read that right), and comedy sharp enough to leave your jaw on the actual floor. Who's performing? Ni idea todavía — you gotta pull up to find out. All-inclusive cast, unrefined and bold energy, feathers flying and heels clicking on that pool table like it's nothing. Esta noche Azúcar se transforma en cabaret, and once La Bon steps on stage there's no looking away. Grab your ticket now antes que se agoten, because a debut like this only happens once. Come thirsty for a show, leave speechless. 🔥🎱

Dim lights, red velvet energy, and heels clicking against a pool table like it's the most natural thing in the world 🎱💃 That's the vibe La Bon is bringing to Azúcar with Sappholicious — our brand new burlesque troop making its debut. Picture slow reveals, sultry stares, corsets and confidence, punchlines landing right between the shimmies. It's unrefined. It's seductive. It's bold, exactly like the flyer promises. The room's gonna smell like perfume and anticipation, la música baja pero la tensión sube, and every set builds until you can't help but gasp out loud. Comedy cuts through just enough to keep you laughing between the sultry moments — this cast knows how to keep you guessing. No two acts feel the same, and that's the whole point. Come feel it for yourself porque describing it doesn't do it justice. 🖤✨

Come exactly as you are, porque tonight's stage belongs to everybody 💗🎭 Sappholicious is Azúcar's very own burlesque troop, hosted by La Bon, and it's built to be all-inclusive from the cast to the crowd. Sultry, funny, a lil unexpected (pool table tricks, anyone?) — this show's for the ones who show up for community as much as for the spectacle. Bring your people, bring your best cheer, and get ready to hype up performers who are about to leave everybody's jaw on the floor. No pretension, no judgment, just a room full of us celebrating art, bodies, and a little bit of chaos together. Azúcar's always been about that familia energy, and this debut is us sharing something we built con mucho amor. So come curious, come loud, come ready to clap for strangers like they're your best friends by the end of the night. 🔥👑
